program:
app "Tasks with dates" list ocean
table dated title text, due date, done bool
remind "A task is due" at dated.due - 1d at 9:00
count(dated where done = no) "open" head
each dated where done = no sort due as r
  row card gap 2 tap edit r swipe remove r
    toggle r.done
    stack grow
      r.title bold
      r.due small color if(r.due < today, bad, muted)
form dated
"Done" faint
list dated where done = yes
describe:
Tasks with dates, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- dated: title: text; due: date; done: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- text: how many dated entries where done is no, "open".
- for each dated where done is no sorted by due:
  - a group; a tap opens the dated for editing; a swipe removes the dated, with undo:
    - a tick box for the done of the dated.
    - text: the title of the dated.
    - text: the due of the dated.
- a form to add a dated.
- text: "Done".
- a list of dated where done is yes; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
Reminder "A task is due" on each due of the dated entries, 24 hours before at 9:00.

fuller_style: one long sentence of 18 to 30 words

program:
app "My Pharmacy stock" pill ocean
table med name text, batch text?, qty num 0.., expiry date, alert date
setting alert_days num = 30 "Alert days before expiry"
state n text = ""
state q num = 0
state ex date = today
field n "Medicine"
field q "Quantity"
field ex "Expiry date"
button "Add" tap add med name = n, qty = q, expiry = ex, alert = ex - alert_days then set n = ""
remind "A medicine expires soon" at med.alert
let soon = count(med, it.expiry - today <= alert_days)
soon "items expire within" alert_days "days" head color if(soon > 0, warn, good)
each med where expiry - today <= alert_days sort expiry as m
  row card tap edit m
    m.name bold grow
    m.qty "left"
    if(m.expiry < today, "Expired", "Expires soon") color if(m.expiry < today, bad, warn)
    m.expiry - today "days" faint
list med
describe:
My Pharmacy stock, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- med: name: text; batch: text, optional; qty: number, at least 0; expiry: date; alert: date. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Alert days before expiry": number, starts at 30.
Works out:
- soon is how many of the med have its expiry minus today is at most alert days.
Remembers while you use it: n, starting at ""; q, starting at 0; ex, starting at today.
Shows:
- a box to fill in n, labelled "Medicine".
- a box to fill in q, labelled "Quantity".
- a box to fill in ex, labelled "Expiry date".
- a button "Add"; a tap adds a med with name set to n, qty set to q, expiry set to ex, alert set to ex minus alert days, then sets n to "".
- text: soon, "items expire within", alert days, "days".
- for each med where expiry minus today is at most alert days sorted by expiry:
  - a group; a tap opens the med for editing:
    - text: the name of the med.
    - text: the qty of the med, "left".
    - text: "Expired" when the expiry of the med is less than today, otherwise "Expires soon".
    - text: the expiry of the med minus today, "days".
- a list of med; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
Reminder "A medicine expires soon" on each alert of the med entries.
hurried_style: lowercase, abbreviations like pls/txt/mins, 3 to 9 words
fuller_style: one sentence of 14 to 22 words, mentions the most special feature first
order: start with who it is for

app "Stopwatch" timer ocean
table lap time dur
state t dur = 0s
state going bool = no
every 1s if going set t = t + 1s
stack align center gap 2
  t big
  row gap 2
    button "Start" fill good tap set going = yes
    button "Stop" fill bad tap set going = no
    button "Lap" tap add lap time = t
    button "Reset" tap set going = no then set t = 0s
each lap sort at desc
  row card
    "Lap" count(lap) - index grow
    it.time bold
remind "Time to check in" at 8:00
describe:

- every 1 seconds while going, it sets t to t plus 1 seconds.
- text: t.

- a button "Stop"; a tap sets going to no.
- a button "Lap"; a tap adds a lap with time set to t.
- a button "Reset"; a tap sets going to no, then sets t to 0 hours.

app "Spare parts" tool ocean
table part name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 5, price money?, kind pick Big|Small|Spare, expires date?
let short = count(part, it.qty <= it.low)
short "parts running low" head color if(short > 0, warn, good)
each part sort qty as i
  row card gap 1 tap edit i swipe remove i
    stack grow
      i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)
      i.kind faint

    i.qty bold
    button "+" tap set i.qty = i.qty + 1
"Stock value" sum(part, it.qty * it.price) faint
form part
remind "Check your parts" at 9:00 on sat
describe:

    - text: the qty of the part.

app "Calorie need" apple mint
state sex pick Male|Female = Male
state age num = 30
state kg num = 70
state cm num = 170

draw 100, 40 width 180
  rect 2, 6, 88, 28 radius 6 stroke ink thick 2
  rect 90, 14, 6, 12 fill ink radius 2
  rect 5, 9, 82 * p, 22 radius 4 fill if(p >= 0.8, good, if(p >= 0.4, warn, bad))

each chap sort at as c
  row card
    c.name grow
    toggle c.done
form chap, "Add chapter"

program:
app "Quran" book mint
table read juz num 1..30, pages num 1..
setting daily num = 10 "Pages a day"
let done = sum(read.pages)
goal done, 604, "pages read", "pages"
grid 10 gap 1
  each 1..30
    box height 22 radius 4 fill if(it <= max(read.juz), accent, soft)
      it tiny align center
"Today" sum(read.pages today) "of" daily "pages" faint
heat last 28 days, sum(read.pages on it), daily
"At this pace you finish in" round((604 - done) * 30 / sum(read.pages last 30 days)) "days" faint
form read
list read by day
describe:
Quran, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- read: juz: number, 1 to 30; pages: number, at least 1. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Pages a day": number, starts at 10.

- done is the total pages of read.
Shows:
- done out of 604 with a progress bar, labelled "pages read".
- a grid of 10 columns:
  - for each number from 1 to 30:
    - text: the number.
- text: "Today", the total pages of read today, "of", daily, "pages".
- a heat map of the total pages of read on that day for each day in the last 28 days.
- text: "At this pace you finish in", the result of 604 minus done times 30 divided by the total pages of read in the last 30 days rounded, "days".
- a form to add a read.
- a list of read by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
